'''Sedore Dajenna''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] and a loyalist [[Sitter]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. She was also secretly part of the [[Black Ajah]].

== Appearance and Personality==
She was plump and had a round face with dark eyes and long dark hair. In Elaida’s opinion, she was one of the most arrogant of all among the sisters.{{verify}}

==Strength amd Abilities==
Sedore is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|25}}. She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a [[Traveling|gateway]] of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

==History==
When Sedore died, she was 187 years old. Born in [[Tear]] in {{ne|813}}, Sedore went to the [[White Tower]] in [[829 NE]]. After spending nine years as a [[novice]] and seven years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in [[845 NE]].

She was elected Sitter in [[961 NE]] and is a high-ranking sister. By the time of the series, this would have made her one of the most senior Sitters in terms of continuous tenure, second only to [[Saerin Asnobar]].

==Activities==
She stood to depose [[Siuan Sanche]]. During the [[White Tower Schism]], she remained loyal to the White Tower. [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] gave her a penance of [[Mortification of the Spirit]].

She was one of the Sitters meeting with Elaida when [[Alviarin Freidhen]] returned to the White Tower. Elaida made her nervous, and so did mention of forkroot.

A list of Black Ajah members given to [[Egwene al'Vere]] by [[Verin Mathwin]] confirmed that Sedore was a [[Darkfriend]], but she managed to escape the Tower. In fact, she was a member of the [[Supreme Council|Black Ajah Supreme Council]], and was one of only three women who knew Alviarin's identity as Black Ajah head. The others were [[Galina Casban|Galina]] (Alviarin's second) and [[Velina Behar|Velina]]. (Note: The Wheel of Time Companion has conflicting entries on this; Velina's entry says that Sedore knew Alviarin's identity, but Sedore's own entry states otherwise). 

During the [[Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod|Battle in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'']], Egwene killed Sedore with a manifestation of [[Fire]], not created with the [[One Power]]. {{Ref/book|13|37}} 

If she was in her own body while killed in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'', which Darkfriends tend to do, her soul would be obliterated. Very likely, she was using one of the dream ''[[ter'angreal]]'' stolen by [[Sheriam Bayanar]] and given to [[Mesaana]], which would not have brought her there in the flesh.
